paragraphs: R' Yitzchak son of R' Yosi.
Mentioned in the Zohar, Toldot 138a: he was coming from Cappadocia to Lod when R' Yehudah met him, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קלח. is rendered 138a using the period convention; the terminal period can also be punctuation, so this is not independent verification of a printed side or modern edition.

The headed Yitzchak is the understood traveler, from Cappadocia to Lod, and Yehudah meets him. וכו׳ supplies etc. The full father-title component is retained as R', with all three abbreviated personal titles unexpanded; no further identification is inferred.
